value.name: Asha arrives with legal team
value.description: Asha arrives at the house with her paralegal Marcus, who carries evidence-gathering supplies.
evidence: sidewalk in front of the house with her paralegal, a quiet young man named Marcus who carried a banker's box and a digital camera
The day was bright and cold.
value.location_hint: sidewalk in front of the house

value.name: Rosa stores the umbrella away
value.description: The umbrella that had been in the vestibule is no longer there because Rosa has put it away.
evidence: The umbrella was no longer in the brass stand inside the vestibule; Rosa had put it away.

value.name: Lucia admits Daniel is upstairs
value.description: Lucia opens the door and tells Asha that Daniel is already in the house and has gone up to the sewing room.
evidence: Lucia opened the door this time
"Twenty minutes. He went up to the sewing room."

value.name: Lucia confirms Daniel stayed at doorway
value.description: Lucia reassures Asha that she followed Daniel and made sure he did not enter the sewing room.
evidence: "I followed him. He was standing in the doorway. He didn't go in."

value.name: Group ascends to sewing room
value.description: Asha leads Lucia, Marcus, and Rosa upstairs toward the sewing room, with Rosa joining from the back garden carrying a thermos.
evidence: They went up the stairs in a small procession: Asha first, then Lucia, then Marcus with the box, then — coming in through the kitchen door from the back garden, where she had apparently been waiting — Rosa, in the same navy cardigan, with a thermos.

value.name: Daniel blocks hallway then yields
value.description: Daniel waits at the top of the stairs with folded arms, then steps aside when Asha greets him and asks to proceed.
evidence: At the top of the stairs Daniel was standing in the hallway with his arms folded

value.name: Asha opens sewing room
value.description: Asha opens the sewing-room door to begin the inspection.

value.name: Asha unlocks roll-top desk
value.description: Asha notices the key in the roll-top lock, puts on gloves, turns the key, and opens the desk.
evidence: The key was still in the lock of the roll top.
Asha put on a pair of thin cotton gloves she had brought in her portfolio — theatrical, perhaps, but the theater was the point — and turned the key, and rolled the top up.

value.name: Desk contents are revealed
value.description: The roll-top opens and the wooden slats clatter, revealing the desk's interior as the inspection begins.
